items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: we’ve got a concert in Hackensack with Bucky Pizzarelli, Milt Hinton, Bobby Rosengarden, Zoot Sims and Hank Jones and myself. Can you come?

ctx.x: And someone said, “You look like a Monk with that thing on.” And it stuck.
That’s similar to the moniker that Zoot Sims adopted.
How did he get that, do you know?
